notes: The volume-window setting now measures exactly what its labels say. The maths behind the volume comparison counts calendar days, but the old menu values were trading-day counts — so '1-year average' really averaged about 8 and a half months, and '1-month' about 3 weeks. The menu values are now calendar days, your saved choice is converted automatically, and the Auto option's label is fixed too: since the last update Auto uses the same 3-month window as the server, not 'all history'. If you use Auto (the default), nothing changes.
